notes: Both marginal notes (*Or, of*) were read and set aside; the printed *with* governs (rule 38).

Flagged large units checked morpheme by morpheme: in *a handful* neither `מְלֹא` nor `כַף` owns an English word — the one word carries fullness and hand alike — and in *two handfuls* the *two* writes the dual number of `חָפְנַיִם` rather than a rendering of one morpheme in particular, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met in both and rule 2's split is not available; source heads taken on the governing construct `מְלֹא` under rule 23.
The relational *with* of *with quietness* and *with labor* belongs to the rectum as the chain's own recast relation (rule 19).
